scope: Read-only decomposition of already recorded official STCK known-prefix requests; no execution of native code, test, profile or new performance window; only these two new documentation files are written.

method.warmups: Exclude only trials whose warmup is true, as in the official comparison.
method.pairing: Match guard samples within the same cohort/report/trial and request sequence. This is intra-request pairing, not a paired experimental A/B design.

formulas.guardMs_i: sum(s.elapsedMs for s in same_trial.samples if s.sequence == request.sequence and s.stage == 'known_prefix_guard')
formulas.pooledMedian: For each side separately, pool all 32 request-level differences, sort and average elements 16 and 17 (one-based). Never subtract separately computed medians.

method.nesting: Guard is nested within service and service within request; their reported medians must not be summed. serviceOutsideGuard is a remainder, not an independently timed phase.
method.reproduction: Executable read-only Python snippet included in known-prefix-followup.md; the JSON also contains every selected sample and its source indexes.

findings: The official STCK service and request medians exceed the unchanged +10% gate in both cohorts and their aggregate. The lot remains open; aggregate 14/16 is not changed by this analysis.

The request-level service-minus-guard median rises from 8.600408000002062 ms to 11.045734500001345 ms. The outer residual median rises from 1.7717114999986734 ms to 1.8937200000000303 ms. This locates the unresolved wall-duration increase mainly inside the complete service outside the measured guard, without identifying its cause.
Only known_prefix_guard is an instrumented inner stage at these sequences; no instrumented plan/seal/persistence/restoration sample is present for these requests.
Visible selected work metadata and the listed source modules match. This does not establish equal full payload sizes, allocation histories, JIT state, GC state or scheduling.
Round-to-round ranges are substantial. Two cohort failures cannot be dismissed as noise, and these data do not prove a causal regression from any individual 0.42 edit.
hypothesesNotEstablishedCauses: Repeated validation/copy/hash/measurement/snapshot work may dominate these requests; the existing phase timings do not break it down.
JIT, GC and scheduling may contribute to wall-duration differences; no causal evidence is available here.

A future generic optimization could privately certify a service-created validated/detached/frozen observation and avoid a second runtime clone for that provenance only, retaining defensive processing of foreign inputs.
A future generic optimization could reuse unchanged immutable snapshot branches by revision, while retaining fresh observations, dynamic fields, tickets, traces and every authorization check.

instrumentationNext.work: Validation and detached copies of the current 64 by 64 frame and animation frames; record frame counts and validation/copy time separately.
Construct native public observation, JSON encoding/TextEncoder and async SHA-256 for the frame; distinguish synchronous preparation from await duration.

Command comparison, detached observation clone/freeze, measureNativeObservation, family.after, preservation/witness/note work, authorize, and output. Time these separately without adding nested durations together.
Connected components, async component signatures and entity construction; record public component counts and await duration.
Coverage and family/caller revision maps, authority snapshot, trace outer list and dynamic fields; record branch sizes and revision/identity stability.
Measure detached copy of EPISODE composition_target returned by reasoning-memory get; record target size and whether its revision changed.
Immutable branch checks and reuse, detached copy of remaining snapshot branches, freeze and command/ticket construction; record payload sizes and cache hits.
Keep complete service duration and worker/controller residual separate. Residual includes message cloning/scheduling and worker bookkeeping outside service.handle; it is not pure wire transport.

acceptanceForFutureWork: Use a separately declared bounded diagnostic to attribute the remainder before selecting a correction; do not reinterpret this analysis as a new benchmark.
Preserve point guards, newly observed frames, detached ownership, malformed/foreign input validation, acquisition and checkpoint contracts; add no game- or level-keyed behavior.
Preserve action/query/state witnesses and the predeclared official protocol, +10% threshold and all measured sessions in the next official comparison.
